meanings.en: the act of making something legally void or ineffective
meanings.exampleEn: The court ordered the nullification of the contract.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme sözleşmenin iptaline hükmetti.

meanings.en: an animal that has a backbone
meanings.exampleEn: Fish, birds, and mammals are all vertebrates.
meanings.exampleTr: Balıklar, kuşlar ve memeliler birer omurgalıdır.

meanings.en: not believing in or worshipping a god
meanings.exampleEn: They accused him of leading a godless life.
meanings.exampleTr: Onu tanrısız bir hayat sürmekle suçladılar.

meanings.en: in a sensible and trustworthy way
meanings.exampleEn: Please drink responsibly and don't drive afterwards.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen sorumlu bir şekilde için ve sonrasında araba kullanmayın.

meanings.en: showing a lack of respect or politeness
meanings.exampleEn: It was disrespectful of him to interrupt his teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmeninin sözünü kesmesi saygısızcaydı.

meanings.en: not showing a serious or respectful attitude
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a flippant answer to a very serious question.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok ciddi bir soruya ciddiyetsiz bir cevap verdi.

meanings.en: a clever and witty remark
meanings.exampleEn: He made a quip about the terrible weather.
meanings.exampleTr: Berbat hava hakkında bir espri yaptı.

meanings.en: an aggressive belief in the superiority of one's own group or sex
meanings.exampleEn: Her boss's chauvinism made the workplace unbearable.
meanings.exampleTr: Patronunun şovenizmi iş yerini çekilmez hale getirdi.

meanings.en: showing an aggressive belief in the superiority of one's own group or sex
meanings.exampleEn: He made several chauvinistic remarks about women drivers.
meanings.exampleTr: Kadın sürücüler hakkında birkaç cinsiyetçi yorum yaptı.

meanings.en: a person who makes and repairs wooden things
meanings.exampleEn: The carpenter built a beautiful oak table.
meanings.exampleTr: Marangoz güzel bir meşe masa yaptı.

meanings.en: a person who makes things from wood
meanings.exampleEn: The skilled woodworker carved intricate patterns into the chair.
meanings.exampleTr: Usta ahşap ustası sandalyeye karmaşık desenler oydu.

meanings.en: a feeling of great happiness and triumph
meanings.exampleEn: The crowd cheered in exultation when the team scored.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım gol atınca kalabalık coşkuyla tezahürat yaptı.

meanings.en: confused emotionally or in a state of disorder
meanings.exampleEn: He was a mixed-up teenager who couldn't decide what he wanted.
meanings.exampleTr: Ne istediğine karar veremeyen, kafası karışık bir gençti.

meanings.en: arranged in a neat, orderly, or planned way
meanings.exampleEn: She is very organised and always keeps her desk tidy.
meanings.exampleTr: Çok düzenlidir ve masasını hep derli toplu tutar.

meanings.en: with great care and effort
meanings.exampleEn: She painstakingly restored the old painting over many months.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski tabloyu aylarca büyük bir titizlikle restore etti.

meanings.en: very bad or of very poor quality
meanings.exampleEn: The team's defence was woeful throughout the match.
meanings.exampleTr: Takımın savunması maç boyunca berbattı.

meanings.en: full of sorrow or sadness
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a woeful sigh and looked away.
meanings.exampleTr: Kederli bir iç çekti ve başını çevirdi.

meanings.en: a long, loud cry of pain, grief, or anger
meanings.exampleEn: The wailing of the sirens filled the night.
meanings.exampleTr: Sirenlerin feryadı geceyi doldurdu.

meanings.en: covering a large number of different subjects or a large area
meanings.exampleEn: We had a wide-ranging discussion about politics and economics.
meanings.exampleTr: Siyaset ve ekonomi üzerine geniş kapsamlı bir tartışma yaptık.

meanings.en: being the first of its kind
meanings.exampleEn: The ship sank on its maiden voyage.
meanings.exampleTr: Gemi ilk seferinde battı.

meanings.en: a young unmarried woman
meanings.exampleEn: In the old story, a brave knight rescued the maiden.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski hikayede cesur bir şövalye genç kızı kurtardı.

meanings.en: freedom to act within certain limits
meanings.exampleEn: The boss gave us some leeway to finish the project our own way.
meanings.exampleTr: Patron projeyi kendi yöntemimizle bitirmemiz için bize biraz esneklik tanıdı.

meanings.en: deserving to be blamed or criticised
meanings.exampleEn: His careless behaviour was clearly blameworthy.
meanings.exampleTr: Dikkatsiz davranışı açıkça kınanacak nitelikteydi.

meanings.en: the fact of being allowed by law
meanings.exampleEn: They questioned the legality of the government's decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümetin kararının yasallığını sorguladılar.

meanings.en: the quality of being against the law
meanings.exampleEn: The court confirmed the unlawfulness of the arrest.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme tutuklamanın yasa dışılığını teyit etti.

meanings.en: the fact of being against the law
meanings.exampleEn: The lawyer pointed out the illegality of the contract.
meanings.exampleTr: Avukat sözleşmenin yasa dışılığına dikkat çekti.

meanings.en: a person who does not have special knowledge or skill in a subject
meanings.exampleEn: The book explains the science in a way that a non-expert can understand.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap bilimi uzman olmayan birinin anlayabileceği şekilde açıklıyor.

meanings.en: so wet that drops of liquid fall off
meanings.exampleEn: He came inside with dripping wet clothes.
meanings.exampleTr: İçeri sırılsıklam kıyafetlerle girdi.

meanings.en: the state of being legally or officially acceptable
meanings.exampleEn: You should check the validity of your passport before travelling.
meanings.exampleTr: Seyahat etmeden önce pasaportunun geçerliliğini kontrol etmelisin.

meanings.en: the quality of being logical or well-founded
meanings.exampleEn: No one could doubt the validity of her argument.
meanings.exampleTr: Kimse onun argümanının sağlamlığından şüphe edemezdi.

meanings.en: the fact of not being allowed by law or rules; the state of being unjustified
meanings.exampleEn: Critics stressed the illegitimacy of the new regime.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler yeni rejimin gayrimeşruluğunun altını çizdi.

meanings.tr: laf kalabalığı, gereksiz uzunluk, uzun uzadıya konuşma
meanings.en: the quality of continuing to speak or write for too long in a boring way
meanings.exampleEn: The report's long-windedness made it hard to find the main point.
meanings.exampleTr: Raporun laf kalabalığı ana noktayı bulmayı zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: a person who has the right to use property under a lease
meanings.exampleEn: As the leaseholder, she was responsible for maintaining the flat.
meanings.exampleTr: Kiracı olarak daireyi bakımlı tutmaktan sorumluydu.

meanings.en: a person who leases property to someone else
meanings.exampleEn: The lessor agreed to repair the roof before the tenant moved in.
meanings.exampleTr: Kiraya veren, kiracı taşınmadan önce çatıyı onarmayı kabul etti.

meanings.en: having no energy or enthusiasm
meanings.exampleEn: The hot weather left everyone feeling listless and tired.
meanings.exampleTr: Sıcak hava herkesi halsiz ve yorgun bıraktı.

meanings.en: easily becoming angry or acting without thinking
meanings.exampleEn: His hot-headed reaction only made the argument worse.
meanings.exampleTr: Öfkeli tepkisi tartışmayı sadece daha da kötüleştirdi.

meanings.en: behaviour that is not serious or sensible
meanings.exampleEn: There is no time for frivolity when there is so much work to do.
meanings.exampleTr: Yapılacak bu kadar iş varken ciddiyetsizliğe zaman yok.

meanings.en: a person who saves someone from a dangerous situation
meanings.exampleEn: The rescuers pulled the child from the icy water.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurtarıcılar çocuğu buz gibi sudan çıkardı.

meanings.en: a person who frees others from restriction, slavery, or oppression
meanings.exampleEn: Lincoln is remembered as the great emancipator of the slaves.
meanings.exampleTr: Lincoln, kölelerin büyük özgürleştiricisi olarak hatırlanır.

meanings.en: a person who saves someone or something from danger or difficulty
meanings.exampleEn: The new manager was seen as the saviour of the struggling company.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni müdür, zor durumdaki şirketin kurtarıcısı olarak görüldü.

meanings.en: not pleasant or easy to like
meanings.exampleEn: The main character is cold and thoroughly unlikeable.
meanings.exampleTr: Ana karakter soğuk ve son derece sevimsiz.

meanings.en: the quality of being lively and full of energy
meanings.exampleEn: Her vivacity made her the centre of every party.
meanings.exampleTr: Canlılığı onu her partinin merkezi yapıyordu.

meanings.tr: muhakeme eden kişi, mantık yürüten kişi
meanings.en: a person who thinks about things in a logical way
meanings.exampleEn: She is a careful reasoner who never jumps to conclusions.
meanings.exampleTr: Asla aceleyle sonuca varmayan, dikkatli bir muhakeme insanıdır.

meanings.en: having two sides or parts that are not the same in size or shape
meanings.exampleEn: The dress had an unusual, asymmetrical design.
meanings.exampleTr: Elbisenin sıra dışı, asimetrik bir tasarımı vardı.

meanings.en: having two halves that are exactly the same in size and shape
meanings.exampleEn: A butterfly's wings are perfectly symmetrical.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir kelebeğin kanatları kusursuz derecede simetriktir.

meanings.en: not made or done well; of a low standard
meanings.exampleEn: The shop was selling poor-quality goods at high prices.
meanings.exampleTr: Dükkan yüksek fiyatlarla düşük kaliteli mallar satıyordu.

meanings.en: not of the highest quality; inferior
meanings.exampleEn: The critics dismissed the film as second-rate entertainment.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler filmi ikinci sınıf bir eğlence olarak küçümsedi.

meanings.en: the quality of not being proud or of having a modest opinion of oneself
meanings.exampleEn: He accepted the award with great humbleness.
meanings.exampleTr: Ödülü büyük bir alçakgönüllülükle kabul etti.
